---
title: "Dashboard title"
format: phw-dashboard
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(ggplot2)
library(phwstyle)
use_phw_ggplot()
set.seed(2)
d <- expand.grid(period = 1:13, group = paste("Group", 1:4))
d$value <- round(runif(nrow(d), 10, 60) + d$period * 3)
```

## Row {height=20%}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "First measure"
list(value = 84, color = "primary")
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Second measure"
list(value = 19, color = "info")
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Third measure"
list(value = "12.4", color = "light")
```

## Row {height=80%}

```{r}
#| title: Value by group
plotly_ok <- requireNamespace("plotly", quietly = TRUE)
p <- ggplot(d, aes(period, value, colour = group)) + geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_colour_phw_d(key = "group") + labs(x = "Period", y = "Value")
if (plotly_ok) phw_plotly(p, source = "Example data") else p
```

```{r}
#| title: Latest period
latest <- d[d$period == 13, c("group", "value")]
names(latest) <- c("Group", "Value")
phw_reactable(latest, group_col = "Group", key = "group")
```
